title: Latency
definition: The measure of delay or time taken for an AI system to process an input and return a response to the user. Usually measured in 'Time to First Token' (TTFT) and 'Tokens per Second'.
simpleExplanation: How fast the AI talks back. If you ask a question and have to wait 10 seconds for the first word to appear, the AI has terrible latency.
realWorldExample: A Voice Assistant (like Siri). If the latency is 3 seconds, the conversation feels incredibly unnatural and frustrating. The latency must be under 500 milliseconds for a voice AI to feel like a real human conversation.

basic: What does TTFT stand for in AI performance metrics?
intermediate: Why does generating a 500-word essay take longer for an LLM than classifying an email as Spam/Not Spam?

answers.question: What is TTFT?
answers.answer: Time To First Token. It measures how long the user stares at a blank loading screen before the AI starts typing the very first word.

answers.question: Why does long text take longer?
answers.answer: Because LLMs generate text Autoregressively (one word at a time). To write 500 words, the neural network must run its entire mathematical calculation 500 separate times sequentially.
